aesthetic.direction: Editorial/literary (dark variant) — classical high-contrast serif display on drenched navy with a tracked small-cap eyebrow; a book-jacket / exhibition-poster register
aesthetic.cluster_hint: editorial-serif (brand/marketing register — NOT a macOS UI style cluster)

psychology: Jakob's Law — 'For Paint.NET users' + 'Keep your instincts' sells trained-expectation continuity: users arrive with a mental model, the copy promises no relearning (exploited well)
Aesthetic-Usability Effect — the polished serif/navy composition builds a quality-and-trust prior before the app itself is seen; buys first-contact forgiveness
Von Restorff effect — the one warm/cool canvas artwork is the sole chromatic moment against monochrome navy, so the eye lands there
Processing fluency — serif + generous leading + high contrast read as premium/credible below awareness
